screens.title: The update banner
screens.caption: When a newer Shokker is ready this banner appears under the title bar. Download now or be reminded later (test message shown).
screens.alt: The update banner under the title bar with two buttons.

screens.title: The whole window, labelled
screens.caption: The Pro window with a layered paint loaded and four zones set up.
screens.alt: The full Shokker Paint Booth window with ten numbered callouts.

callouts.label: Header: iRacing User ID, Source Paint, car folder
Spec channel strip (COMBINED, R METAL, G ROUGH, B COAT)

screens.title: APPLY AREA: draw a box or lasso
screens.caption: Limit a zone to an area you draw, on top of its colour or layer choice.
screens.alt: The APPLY AREA section of the zone popout with box and lasso buttons.

screens.title: Zone popout: BASE material and colour sliders
screens.caption: The BASE section: the material, where its colour comes from, and the colour sliders.
screens.alt: The BASE section of the zone popout with nine numbered callouts.

callouts.label: Base material (click to choose a finish)
BASE COLOR source (here: Use source paint, spec only)

screens.title: Zone popout: depth, flip, underglow, spec scale
screens.caption: The lower BASE controls: Color Depth, Color Flip, Underglow, Spec Scale, Spec Rotation and Spec Blend.
screens.alt: The lower BASE controls with six numbered callouts.

screens.title: One zone card
screens.caption: The small buttons on a zone card.
screens.alt: A single zone card with seven numbered callouts.

callouts.label: Eye: switch the zone off or on

screens.title: A zone that shows nothing
screens.caption: A brand-new zone has no finish and no way to pick pixels yet; the card badge and the popout both say so until you give it both.
screens.alt: The ZONES column with an empty Zone 3 and its popout asking for a colour.

callouts.label: Grey dot on the card: no colour picked yet
The popout asks for a base material and a colour
No colour or region set yet: nothing for this zone to cover

screens.title: Zone popout: second base and overlays
screens.caption: The OVERLAYS section: a second base material blended over the first.
screens.alt: The OVERLAYS section with four numbered callouts.

screens.title: Zone popout: COLOR and APPLY AREA
screens.caption: The top of the zone popout panel: which pixels this zone covers.
screens.alt: The top of the zone popout panel with seven numbered callouts.

screens.title: Zone popout: R, G and B channel sliders
screens.caption: Push the metal, roughness and clearcoat channels of a zone up or down.
screens.alt: The three channel sliders R Metal, G Rough and B Coat with numbered callouts.

screens.title: How base, pattern and spec stack in one zone
screens.caption: Every zone builds from BASE first, then SPEC OVERLAYS and PATTERN on top, then the OVERLAYS stack.
screens.alt: The zone popout sections BASE, SPEC OVERLAYS, PATTERN and OVERLAYS in order.

callouts.label: SPEC OVERLAYS (detail in the shine, on top of BASE above)

screens.title: Zone popout: spec overlays and pattern
screens.caption: Add a spec overlay (detail in how the surface reflects) or a paint pattern.
screens.alt: Spec overlays and pattern sections with four numbered callouts.

screens.title: Auto-Pop and spec presets (Feels)
screens.caption: Under Spec Sliders: one click of Auto-Pop for a safe boost of shine, and the Feels preset list.
screens.alt: The Auto-Pop button and spec preset list in the zone popout.

screens.title: Spec Strength and independent spec scale
screens.caption: Spec Strength fades the spec toward neutral; the Spec Scale box lets the spec have its own size apart from the paint.
screens.alt: Spec Strength and Spec Scale controls in the zone popout.

callouts.label: Spec Scale (tick to make it independent)

screens.title: The ZONES column
screens.caption: Every zone is a card. The top card wins where zones overlap.
screens.alt: The left column listing five zones with numbered callouts.

screens.title: Zones: the More menu
screens.caption: Presets gallery, randomise, apply one finish to all zones, save as template and load a SHOKK file.
screens.alt: The zone More menu open with numbered items.
